name: Resource sentinel
description: Samples host disk, memory and CPU, plus this instance's event-loop responsiveness, on a schedule and alerts you ONLY when one crosses its warning threshold — quiet when everything is healthy. Uses only built-in system stats (no extra software to install) and works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Memory uses true available memory on Linux and Windows; macOS doesn't expose that to a pure check, so memory is shown there but not alerted on. Disk, memory and CPU read the HOST machine, so in a Hub (many instances on one machine) enabling it on a single instance covers the host for those. The event-loop check is specific to the instance it runs on, so enable it on each instance you want watched. Read-only: it checks the machine, it never places or changes a trade.
